tasks.title: Inline brief pre-flight validator early in harness/planner/cli.py:main
acceptance_criteria: Validation logic is inlined in main() of harness/planner/cli.py.
No top-level functions or classes (e.g. check_brief_preflight) are added.
The edit is a single-symbol patch on main using __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__.

spec.objective: Insert the inline pre-flight validation block in cli.main immediately after state_dir = Path('state') and before the existing try/except block to catch malformed briefs early.
functional_requirements: Parse headings and collect missing/empty required sections.
Analyze ## TASK sections for missing integration or edge_case/regression mentions.
Validate consistency of required_task_ids with sections.
Wrap block in try/except Exception to fail-open, exit with code 2 on violations.
spec.interfaces: Inline validation logic in main() inside harness/planner/cli.py.
edge_cases: Files are read with utf-8 encoding. Read failures are caught and appended as unreadable_brief without raising.
Task ID is extracted from canonical bullet directive, taking the last matching bullet to avoid prose decoys.
non_goals: No integration testing with the live daemon is performed in this unit oracle.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Runs on synthetic briefs in tests.

tasks.title: Author hermetic unit tests in tests/harness/test_brief_preflight_validator.py for brief pre-flight validator in cli.main
acceptance_criteria: tests/harness/test_brief_preflight_validator.py is overwritten with a RED hermetic oracle.
Imports only from harness.planner.cli import main (no import of check_brief_preflight or BriefViolation).
Asserts SystemExit(2), 'validation failed' stderr, and correct error substrings for missing title/integration/edge case.
Asserts well-formed brief proceeds to blind_drafts (raises ReachedBlindDrafts).
Asserts deterministic behavior for two identical runs.

spec.objective: Overwrites tests/harness/test_brief_preflight_validator.py with unit and integration-level mock tests verifying the preflight validation in cli.main.
functional_requirements: Assert that a brief missing '# Title' heading causes cli.main to exit with code 2 and a validation failed stderr message mentioning 'title'.
Assert that a brief with a task section missing the word 'integration' causes cli.main to exit with code 2 and a validation failed stderr message mentioning the task ID.
Assert that a brief with a task section missing edge_case/regression guidance causes cli.main to exit with code 2.
Assert that a well-formed brief proceeds past the preflight check, raising a custom base exception from a mock of blind_drafts.
Assert that preflight checks are deterministic.
edge_cases: Decoy task_id in prose is not mistaken for a task bullet.
A base exception is used to verify blind_drafts is reached so it escapes try-except Exception blocks.
non_goals: No integration testing with the live daemon is performed in this unit oracle.
spec.implementation_notes: Write tests using pytest and tmp_path. Mock load_config and check_brief_depth. Mock blind_drafts to track calls or raise exceptions.
